reviews.feedback: internal/store/types.go:251-252: PreviousSecret and SecretRotatedAt are tagged json:"-", but internal/store/state.go Export and internal/snapshot/snapshot.go:30 persist the store as JSON. After a snapshot save and reload, a rotated endpoint loses PreviousSecret, so during the 24-hour window deliveries carry only the new v1 entry, which breaks the spec. Give these fields JSON tags that persist them (e.g. json:"previous_secret,omitempty" and json:"secret_rotated_at,omitempty"), and keep the secrets out of the API response (e.g. a separate response type or a MarshalJSON that omits them). Add a snapshot round-trip test covering a rotated endpoint with PreviousSecret and SecretRotatedAt set, since the existing DeepEqual test in internal/snapshot/snapshot_test.go:33 does not exercise these fields.
